summary: Task gate for cache-bug-T1: one cold read (task-mttz6nle-ok6kd7) returned six findings; the human chose to cover inline lanes in T1; the remaining findings were repository-answered and folded into the re-recorded decomposition contract and the re-saved task plan in one amendment.
current_flow: Live turn: getAgentTurnContext selects the newest resumable provider session (promoting ready) → prepareCompactionDeltaReplay (stale/too-large delta marks degraded then expireProviderSession on the READY row) → fingerprint check (expireProviderSession, void) → createSessionAgentRun → invokeAgent with resumeExternalSessionId; on missing-session error expireTurnProviderSession (void) then retry without resume; after each output persistProviderSessionFromOutput (setSession inserts/updates the handle and DELETES prior rows) and recordRuntimeModelUsage (normalised usage, contextUsage). Claude runner: result-error branch throws bare Error before normalising usage; runner/index.ts catch writes a bare error frame. DeepAgents: normaliser accumulates usage locally and throws without it; index.ts catch writes a bare error frame. Inline lanes mirror both. /new: resetScope deletes provider-session rows in a transaction and returns void; canonical-ops-repo.postgres.ts deleteSession discards the result. No context measure is stored anywhere; totalBillableInputTokens = input - cacheRead.
